flags.message: Frozen distribution_count=2 counts the May 26 distribution of sealing motion 25M86 (conference 6/11/2026) alongside the petition's own single distribution (June 24, for the 9/28/2026 long conference, not yet held). The petition has never been considered at a conference, so the elevated band partly reflects motion practice rather than petition trajectory; relist-increment resolves from the count as frozen, which both sides of the resolution share, but the band-conditioned baseline may be generous to this docket.
